epics.title: Foundation contracts provenance and verification harness
epics.intent: Create stable seams and honest evidence before domain fan-out.
exit_criteria: Contracts frozen; module and real-boundary test harness exist; public provenance and ownership gates recorded.

tasks.title: Create the minimal module and test harness
tasks.objective: Module compiles and test harness can create isolated database schemas.
instructions: Choose supported toolchain versions from official sources and record the supported matrix.
Create the module with standard-library-first dependencies; no speculative packages.
Add real test-database setup with explicit required-service failure instead of silent skips.
Document local prerequisite checks and scoped test entrypoints.
acceptance: Module compiles and test harness can create isolated database schemas.
Missing required database produces a visible failure in integration mode.
tasks.negative_test: Configure a missing test database and confirm integration mode fails.

tasks.title: Freeze cross-lane semantic contracts
tasks.objective: Every shared field and operation-policy extension has defined semantics and ownership.
instructions: Resolve proposed principal/workspace/grant/entitlement contracts without implementing domain policy.
Freeze package ownership, route namespaces, schema fragment assembly and migration allocation.
Define idempotency/errors/assurance/MCP exposure metadata with positive and rejected fixtures.
Publish compatibility and amendment procedure; reconcile all dependent contracts before dispatch.
acceptance: Every shared field and operation-policy extension has defined semantics and ownership.
Required policy omissions and unknown fields are rejected by schema fixtures.
tasks.negative_test: Delete required permission metadata from an operation and expect schema rejection.

tasks.title: Build durable migration and transaction fixtures
tasks.objective: Repeated/concurrent migration yields one consistent schema ledger.
instructions: Implement application-owned database handle and context-bounded transaction helpers.
Create checksum ledger and cross-process migration lock with explicit transactional/nontransactional rules.
Add repeated/concurrent migrate and changed-checksum rejection cases using real SQL.
Reserve migration numbering to integrator; domains contribute namespaced fragments.
acceptance: Repeated/concurrent migration yields one consistent schema ledger.
Changed applied migration fails and leaves existing data intact.
tasks.negative_test: Modify an applied migration checksum in a test fixture and verify rejection.

tasks.title: Qualify dependency and publication provenance
tasks.objective: Every selected dependency has origin/license/version/evidence and a reuse or gap verdict.
instructions: Inventory public AMSL contracts, maturity, immutable releases and tested consumer boundaries.
Compare established dependencies before requesting new shared abstractions.
Record file-level source/publication clearance for any proposed import without publishing restricted evidence.
Select original-work license through owner decision; preserve third-party notices; blocked sources are not copied.
acceptance: Every selected dependency has origin/license/version/evidence and a reuse or gap verdict.
No restricted source or publication-unqualified code enters the release inventory.
tasks.negative_test: A fixture containing a prohibited private source locator is rejected.
tasks.external_gate: Owner chooses original-work license and clears any restricted-source import before copying.

tasks.title: Create API and browser verification harnesses
tasks.objective: Harness exercises a real route and browser page, including one failed request.
instructions: Start a composed app against isolated real SQL and synthetic providers in test-only code.
Add real HTTP request/status/body assertions plus browser golden/edge helpers.
Keep provider fixture wiring unreachable in production binaries.
Separate credential-free and opt-in provider runs and make skipped gates explicit.
Pin Playwright in the isolated browser harness; the wrapper accepts documented suite selectors used by task contracts, asserts nonzero selected tests and propagates browser failures.
acceptance: Harness exercises a real route and browser page, including one failed request.
Production build cannot select provider test doubles.
tasks.negative_test: Break route policy wiring and confirm the boundary test fails.

tasks.title: Enforce public artifact and secret hygiene
tasks.objective: Public artifact checker rejects synthetic secrets and private locators without echoing their values.
instructions: Define disallowed local/private paths and sensitive data patterns without storing real secrets.
Check tracked and proposed publication files; permit only documented synthetic fixtures.
Exclude local inputs/coordination/credentials from public artifacts.
Test detection using synthetic secrets and private-path fixtures.
acceptance: Public artifact checker rejects synthetic secrets and private locators without echoing their values.
tasks.negative_test: Insert a synthetic credential into a fixture and require nonzero sanitized output.

tasks.title: Record license and contribution/security policy
tasks.objective: License, notices and contribution/security guidance consistently cover shipped sources.
instructions: Apply the owner-selected license only after source clearance.
Document contributor accountability, generated contributions, public evidence and private vulnerability handling.
State source/security review and supported-version responsibilities.
acceptance: License, notices and contribution/security guidance consistently cover shipped sources.
tasks.negative_test: A required third-party notice removed from the release fixture fails validation.

tasks.title: Wire formatter linter and shared validation entrypoints
tasks.objective: Deliberately malformed formatting and an ignored-error fixture fail the appropriate check.
instructions: Pin selected linter/tool versions; keep Go formatting canonical.
Provide scoped checks and full integration gates without paid provider calls.
Ensure required SQL/browser jobs cannot silently skip and document heavy-build scheduling.
acceptance: Deliberately malformed formatting and an ignored-error fixture fail the appropriate check.
tasks.negative_test: Run against a malformed fixture and observe the predicted failure.

tasks.title: Reconcile specialist contracts and certify first execution lane
tasks.objective: One intended coding-agent tier completes one identified task with reviewed evidence, or an explicit blocker is recorded.
instructions: Resolve provisional paths, provider choices and cross-lane dependencies using actual foundation code.
Select one bounded cheap-tier task and dispatch only after permissions and inputs exist.
Record observed execution evidence; revise underspecified contract if the task fails.
Do not mark any remaining task certified from this one trial.
acceptance: One intended coding-agent tier completes one identified task with reviewed evidence, or an explicit blocker is recorded.
No invented certification or universal model-success claim.
tasks.negative_test: An unresolved placeholder dependency fails plan validation.

tasks.title: Implement bounded durable jobs and transactional outbox seam
tasks.objective: Committed intent survives restart and stale lease holders cannot commit local job completion; remote effects rely on provider idempotency and reconciliation, not impossible exactly-once fencing.
instructions: Implement durable intent, lease/fencing, retry budget, deadline and terminal/unknown states using the application database.
Allow domain writes and outbox insertion in one transaction; no generic runtime workflow engine.
Define restart recovery and idempotent consumer contracts for email/billing/lifecycle jobs.
Exercise concurrent workers, lease loss and lost external responses with test-only effect doubles.
acceptance: Committed intent survives restart and stale lease holders cannot commit local job completion; remote effects rely on provider idempotency and reconciliation, not impossible exactly-once fencing.
Unknown remote outcomes reconcile rather than blindly replay non-idempotent effects.
tasks.negative_test: Expire a worker lease while a competing worker claims the job; stale completion must be rejected.
risks: Provisional cross-domain seam; revalidate consumers and ownership at T1.2.

tasks.title: Implement configured email delivery adapter and truthful local fixture
tasks.objective: Delivery uses the configured provider adapter, redacts credentials/messages and never reports simulated production success.
instructions: Freeze an EmailSender interface with secret references, bounded templates, recipient/privacy and error semantics.
Qualify AWS SES as the proposed initial provider using the maintained AWS SDK; keep selection visible if changed.
Send only from durable owned intents with backoff and unknown outcome handling.
Keep synthetic delivery in test-only injection and expose setup/unavailable when production sender is not configured.
acceptance: Delivery uses the configured provider adapter, redacts credentials/messages and never reports simulated production success.
Golden and provider failure cases preserve durable email intent without arbitrary recipient content in logs.
tasks.negative_test: Remove provider configuration and verify production dispatch fails visibly rather than capturing an email as if sent.
risks: Provisional cross-domain seam; revalidate consumers and ownership at T1.2.

tasks.title: Implement redacted tenant-scoped security audit sink
tasks.objective: Material mutation produces a scoped durable event and another workspace cannot retrieve it.
instructions: Define actor/action/resource/outcome/correlation/time records and strict field allowlist.
Record material lifecycle/security mutations transactionally or with the outbox.
Separate operational logs from durable security events and enforce current workspace/operator access.
Bound retention/pagination and test denied cross-tenant reads plus sensitive-field rejection.
acceptance: Material mutation produces a scoped durable event and another workspace cannot retrieve it.
Secret values and arbitrary request bodies are not accepted by the event schema.
tasks.negative_test: Submit an event containing a synthetic token field and require schema rejection without echoing it.
risks: Provisional cross-domain seam; revalidate consumers and ownership at T1.2.

tasks.title: Implement tenant-safe export and object-store seam
tasks.objective: Authorized lifecycle job can persist/retrieve an expiring synthetic export without exposing another workspace object.
instructions: Define owner-scoped object references, bounded streaming, encryption requirements and expiry.
Use maintained provider SDK for S3 and a separate local test-only store.
Generate exports through authenticated lifecycle jobs; bind download authorization to current owner/request state.
Test missing object, expired export, cross-tenant request and delete/retention outcomes.

Serve exports through an authenticated AMOS download boundary with current-state checks. Do not use bearer presigned URLs when immediate revocation is required; define any later bounded-expiry exception explicitly.
acceptance: Authorized lifecycle job can persist/retrieve an expiring synthetic export without exposing another workspace object.
tasks.negative_test: Try a different tenant object reference and require denial at the actual object-access boundary.
risks: Provisional cross-domain seam; revalidate consumers and ownership at T1.2.

epics.title: Contract generator runtime composition and reference business app
epics.intent: Prove a useful integrated application path from contract to paid feature.
exit_criteria: Generated typed transport integrates with durable business behavior and a reproducible reference journey.

tasks.title: Implement contract validation and generator command foundation
tasks.objective: Same input produces byte-identical generated transport output.
instructions: Qualify/pin maintained OpenAPI tooling and restrict supported schema features.
Validate operation IDs, policy extensions and names before generation.
Generate deterministically into owned transport files with a manifest.
Reject unsupported constructs with location-aware errors and no partial overwrite.
acceptance: Same input produces byte-identical generated transport output.
Unsupported schema or missing policy exits nonzero without changing handwritten files.
tasks.negative_test: Remove operation policy metadata and confirm generation refuses the contract.

tasks.title: Implement application composition and route ownership seam
tasks.objective: A generated app can mount a business route and a shared route at the same origin.
instructions: Provide exported app composition options consumed by generated applications.
Register shared and business route namespaces explicitly; reject collisions.
Implement health/readiness and bounded shutdown without fabricated dependency success.
Keep domain imports behind small consumer-side interfaces.
acceptance: A generated app can mount a business route and a shared route at the same origin.
Duplicate/reserved route collisions and unhealthy required dependencies fail visibly.
tasks.negative_test: Register a business handler over a reserved identity path and require failure.

tasks.title: Generate Go models and typed implementation interfaces
tasks.objective: Generated code compiles against a handwritten implementation that remains unchanged after regeneration.
instructions: Generate typed request/response/error models and business handler interfaces.
Keep implementation hooks outside managed transport output.
Compile a generated miniature consumer and test regeneration after a schema amendment.
acceptance: Generated code compiles against a handwritten implementation that remains unchanged after regeneration.
tasks.negative_test: Change an input field contract and detect an incompatible implementation at compile/check time.

tasks.title: Create the reference business contract and durable resource
tasks.objective: Resource survives restart and another workspace cannot read or mutate it.
instructions: Use a synthetic shared-workspace todo/resource example with create/list/update/delete operations.
Persist resource ownership and constrain queries by verified workspace.
Use parameterized SQL and optimistic concurrency for updates.
Preserve original examples and avoid importing customer data.
acceptance: Resource survives restart and another workspace cannot read or mutate it.
tasks.negative_test: Remove the workspace predicate in an isolated test mutation and require cross-tenant test failure.

tasks.title: Connect reference feature to identity and paid admission
tasks.objective: Unauthenticated, wrong-workspace and unpaid calls fail while qualified paid calls persist a resource.
instructions: Resolve current principal/workspace before domain calls.
Require the configured paid feature at the backend; unavailable remains retryable unavailable.
Exercise allowed/denied/revoked and pending-payment states through real HTTP handlers.
acceptance: Unauthenticated, wrong-workspace and unpaid calls fail while qualified paid calls persist a resource.
tasks.negative_test: Replace an entitlement denial with allow and confirm denied-path test fails.

tasks.title: Implement reference landing and business pages
tasks.objective: Browser can create/read an allowed resource; forbidden/stale/invalid form cases are visible and safe.
instructions: Create developer-owned landing and resource pages with server-rendered forms and HTMX enhancements.
Render untrusted text safely; preserve ordinary navigation and server validation.
Provide responsive keyboard-accessible create/list/edit states and honest pending/unavailable messages.
acceptance: Browser can create/read an allowed resource; forbidden/stale/invalid form cases are visible and safe.
tasks.negative_test: Render a synthetic HTML payload and assert it remains text, not executable markup.

tasks.title: Write reproducible quickstart and local rehearsal
tasks.objective: A reviewer can reproduce the local reference journey and a denied action from the written instructions.
instructions: Document empty-repository initialization, required services and provider prerequisites.
Label fixture-only flows, local-only modes and every unavailable feature.
Rehearse the written commands from a fresh temporary checkout and record actual outcomes.
acceptance: A reviewer can reproduce the local reference journey and a denied action from the written instructions.
tasks.negative_test: Removing a required setup step causes the rehearsal to fail visibly.

tasks.title: Implement shared operation policy and durable invocation boundary
tasks.objective: All transports can consume one current-state invocation decision and duplicate payload-bound mutations cannot silently repeat.
instructions: Resolve verified principal/current workspace before any operation, keeping selection separate from authority.
Evaluate permissions/entitlements/assurance from the operation registry and return allowed/denied/unavailable faithfully.
Bind idempotency to actor, workspace, operation and canonical payload; conflict on changed intent.
Invoke domain work under defined transaction/outbox ownership and record material audit results.
Expose one adapter seam used by web/REST/MCP/proxy transports; never permit transport-specific authorization shortcuts.
acceptance: All transports can consume one current-state invocation decision and duplicate payload-bound mutations cannot silently repeat.
Revoked membership and stale billing state produce the documented denied/unavailable outcomes at the real boundary.
tasks.negative_test: Change only the browser control while retaining the backend denial, then prove forged direct API mutation still fails.
risks: Security-sensitive seam requires independent review and real transport denial tests.

tasks.title: Implement private-service identity signer and verifier adapter
tasks.objective: Only trusted short-lived service assertions reach the intended origin; forged/stale/cross-audience assertions are rejected.
instructions: Freeze a maintained-library signed assertion or mutual-TLS binding selected by T12.4; do not invent cryptography.
Bind installation/service audience, actor/workspace/scopes, method/path, expiry and key identity to the private hop.
Keep signing authority separate from customer grants and strip any externally supplied equivalent headers.
Qualify key rotation, stale assertions, cross-audience misuse, replay policy and clock skew.
acceptance: Only trusted short-lived service assertions reach the intended origin; forged/stale/cross-audience assertions are rejected.
tasks.negative_test: Replay a valid assertion against another service audience or path and require verification failure.
risks: Security-sensitive seam requires independent review and real transport denial tests.

epics.title: Composed qualification release and operational acceptance
epics.intent: Qualify composed behavior and live claims separately from package completion.
exit_criteria: Each released stage has actual required evidence and explicit unsupported boundaries.

tasks.title: Create executable release capability matrix
tasks.objective: An unsupported advertised capability or missing mandatory evidence blocks the release.
instructions: List each advertised capability and required API/browser/provider/cloud/client evidence.
Record implemented/tested/qualified/deployed/rehearsed states separately.
Make missing mandatory evidence fail release promotion.
acceptance: An unsupported advertised capability or missing mandatory evidence blocks the release.
tasks.negative_test: Delete a mandatory evidence record and require failure

tasks.title: Accept credential-free composed reference journey
tasks.objective: Composed local journey passes positive and denied cases; no required test silently skips.
instructions: Run the real SQL/API/browser composition with test-only identity and payment providers.
Verify paid/unpaid/pending/unavailable, duplicate event and revoked-session behavior.
Record exact inputs/revisions/test results without describing them as live provider evidence.
acceptance: Composed local journey passes positive and denied cases; no required test silently skips.
tasks.negative_test: Disable backend admission and require the composed denial test to fail

tasks.title: Verify identity and payment provider lifecycle
tasks.objective: Actual selected providers complete the test-mode journey and errors; provider fixtures cannot satisfy this gate.
instructions: Use approved test accounts for the baseline password/email and flat personal-subscription profile; full selected provider methods are qualified by T16.6.
Complete actual identity login, test checkout payment, webhook receipt, portal, cancellation and policy transitions.
Exercise delayed events and provider outages; preserve cleanup receipts without private account ids.
acceptance: Actual selected providers complete the test-mode journey and errors; provider fixtures cannot satisfy this gate.
tasks.negative_test: Reject a forged provider callback/webhook and retain denied paid access
tasks.external_gate: Owner-approved provider accounts, credentials, test catalog and callback setup

tasks.title: Verify cloud deployment and same-domain routing
tasks.objective: Real public domain serves the correct artifact and private boundaries reject unauthorized access.
instructions: Deploy an immutable reviewed artifact using scoped owner credentials.
Observe public TLS, shared and business routes, readiness and current-state denied access.
Verify private origins/database cannot be bypassed and telemetry contains no secrets.
acceptance: Real public domain serves the correct artifact and private boundaries reject unauthorized access.
tasks.negative_test: An attempted direct-origin request without valid authority is denied
tasks.external_gate: Explicit infrastructure budget, deployment approval and domain ownership

tasks.title: Rehearse rollback and independent data restore
tasks.objective: A demonstrated release recovery and separate data restore pass without resurrecting revoked authority.
instructions: Inject a bounded failed release and verify rollback eligibility and health.
Restore a backup into an isolated destination; compare synthetic records and identity revocation state.
Document RPO/RTO observations and operations that cannot safely roll back.
acceptance: A demonstrated release recovery and separate data restore pass without resurrecting revoked authority.
tasks.negative_test: A restored revoked credential must remain unusable

tasks.title: Accept complete authentication and workspace matrix
tasks.objective: Every advertised authentication/workspace flow has reviewed allowed/denied evidence and honest provider limitations.
instructions: Verify every selected method, linking/recovery and organization enforcement in supported environments.
Exercise membership race, last-owner prevention, account disable and expired/replayed flow denial.
Record actual enterprise OIDC and passkey/device compatibility evidence.
acceptance: Every advertised authentication/workspace flow has reviewed allowed/denied evidence and honest provider limitations.
tasks.negative_test: Reuse a completed challenge or remove a member during access and require denial

tasks.title: Accept flat seat and usage billing matrix
tasks.objective: All three pricing models converge to documented entitlement and invoice expectations under retries.
instructions: Verify separate personal and organization billing ownership.
Exercise seat races, period cutover, usage replay/correction, mixed-plan rules and reconciliation.
Verify refund/dispute/unknown/freshness behavior matches frozen policy.
acceptance: All three pricing models converge to documented entitlement and invoice expectations under retries.
tasks.negative_test: Replay usage and out-of-order payment events without creating duplicate charges

tasks.title: Accept REST MCP and separate-service equivalence
tasks.objective: Supported interfaces agree on policy outcomes and no private upstream bypass succeeds.
instructions: Run equivalent allowed/denied business cases through web, REST, API keys and actual supported MCP clients.
Verify resumable proof-required flows and grant revocation.
Exercise a non-Go private upstream including redirects/cookies/streaming and header forgery.
acceptance: Supported interfaces agree on policy outcomes and no private upstream bypass succeeds.
tasks.negative_test: Inject a forged identity header and require identical denial through proxy and API

tasks.title: Accept upgrade PR and custom UI compatibility
tasks.objective: Compatible changes preserve custom work and incompatible changes stop with actionable diffs.
instructions: Upgrade a real generated consumer with theme-only, page override and fully custom UI variants.
Verify immutable pins, file ownership, conflict stops, migration compatibility and rollback limits.
Observe an actual scoped upgrade PR without exposing credentials or customer code.
acceptance: Compatible changes preserve custom work and incompatible changes stop with actionable diffs.
tasks.negative_test: Modify a generated managed-file preimage and require a conflict rather than overwrite
tasks.external_gate: Approved test repository for real upgrade PR verification

tasks.title: Accept private maintenance security boundaries
tasks.objective: Eligible fix advances; malicious/unknown/high-risk cases halt without production authority or data exfiltration.
instructions: Run a synthetic bug through an independent agent, verifier and policy-limited release.
Attempt instruction injection, forbidden workflow edits, credential access and evidence replay.
Verify spend/retry bounds, kill switch and failed-canary recovery.
acceptance: Eligible fix advances; malicious/unknown/high-risk cases halt without production authority or data exfiltration.
tasks.negative_test: Submit a patch that weakens required tests and require protected verification rejection

tasks.title: Accept upstream repair and private-data exclusion
tasks.objective: Shared correction reaches a qualified consumer while prohibited diagnostic fields and private patches are rejected.
instructions: Submit only allowlisted synthetic diagnostics, deduplicate and reproduce a shared defect.
Exercise a reviewed upstream fix through versioned release to consumer upgrade PR.
Verify private disclosure routing and that restricted source never leaves the owner boundary.
acceptance: Shared correction reaches a qualified consumer while prohibited diagnostic fields and private patches are rejected.
tasks.negative_test: Embed a synthetic secret/path in a crash report and require rejection before egress
tasks.external_gate: Approved test repositories and release identities

tasks.title: Publish honest supported release and operator handoff
tasks.objective: A released artifact has complete required evidence and reproducible installation/operating instructions.
instructions: Verify source, artifacts, notices, evidence and support matrix identify the same release.
Publish only with explicit release authority; record public verification and known limitations.
Hand off security response, deprecation, backup, cost and maintenance-stop procedures.
acceptance: A released artifact has complete required evidence and reproducible installation/operating instructions.
tasks.negative_test: Substitute an artifact digest and require release identity/evidence validation failure
